# ThunderStudy AI

> ThunderStudy AI is a free educational tool at https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in. Its Formula Story Mode turns any formula or concept into a memorable story, real-life analogy or memory trick. It is owned, built and maintained by Wondermayank, a solo student developer who has been building free educational tools since 2018.

Last updated: 3 October 2026

## Key facts

- Site name: ThunderStudy AI (also written ThunderStudy)
- Domain: formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in
- Owner and developer: Wondermayank (solo student developer, building free educational tools since 2018)
- Contact: contact@wondermayank.indevs.in
- Cost: free. No account, no card, no paid plan, no ads.
- Fair-use limit: 5 AI stories per day and 15 per week.
- Audience: students preparing for school exams and for JEE, NEET, SSC, NTA and Banking exams in India.
- Language: English (en-IN)
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages. Static HTML pages with a small serverless function (/api/generate) that calls the AI model, so the API key is never exposed in the browser.
- Data: saved stories and the daily/weekly usage count are stored in the visitor's own browser (localStorage). There is no sign-up.
- Accuracy: stories are written by AI and can contain mistakes. Users should check important formulas against their textbook or official exam material.

## Pages and tools

### Landing page: https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/
Direct answer: ThunderStudy AI is a free tool that turns any formula or concept into a memorable story, real-life analogy or memory trick, built by Wondermayank for students of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology. Lists the subjects covered (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Economics, any subject) and links to the tool.

### Formula Story Mode: https://formula.thunderstudy.indevs.in/home
The main tool. In short: Formula Story Mode is a free AI tool that turns any formula or topic into a story, a real-life analogy or a memory trick, with up to 5 stories a day and 15 a week and a Save as PDF option.
- Input: any topic or formula, for example E = mc², Newton's Laws, Pythagoras Theorem, Ohm's Law, Photosynthesis, Quadratic Formula, Boyle's Law.
- Three output styles:
  - Story Mode: wraps the formula in an immersive story.
  - Real-Life Analogy: compares the formula to something from everyday life.
  - Memory Trick: gives a short hook to recall the formula.
  - Each comes with a step-by-step breakdown of the formula.
- Actions on a result: Save as PDF, Copy Text, Regenerate.
- Saved Stories: a history kept on the user's device, with a Clear all option.
- Free library: ready-made formula stories for PCMB Class 11 and 12, JEE, NEET, SSC, NTA and Banking subjects. They are free to read and do not use any of the daily generations.
- Limits: 5 AI stories a day and 15 a week, to keep the free AI engine available to everyone.
